steps.name: Price Structure Definition
steps.blurb: Segmentation, master-data hierarchy, reference price framework, approval governance.

steps.name: Initial Price Creation
steps.blurb: New-part pricing, cost-plus / mark-up methods, bulk loads, replacements, bundles.

steps.name: Central Price Adjustments
steps.blurb: Cost-triggered repricing, surcharges, tariffs, FX threshold recalculation, channel linkage.

steps.name: HQ → Market Handover
steps.blurb: Releasing approved central prices to markets: controlled, transparent, confirmed receipt.

steps.name: Market Price Derivation
steps.blurb: Local retail and dealer-net derivation, applying FX, markups, corridors, and local rules.

steps.name: Market Price Changes
steps.blurb: Targeted local adjustments, differentiated increases, simulation toward targets, approvals.

steps.name: Campaigns & Special Prices
steps.blurb: Promotional prices, key-account specials, distributor lists, dealer bonuses, agreements.

steps.name: Price Publication & Distribution
steps.blurb: Publishing approved prices to ERP, logistics, invoicing: timing, receipt, consistency.

steps.name: Audit, History & Compliance
steps.blurb: Full traceability of every price change (who, what, when, why) with long-term retention.

roadmapPhases.name: Diagnose
roadmapPhases.blurb: Establish the baseline: data hierarchy, segmentation, corridors, the margin model and the leakage map.

roadmapPhases.name: Transform
roadmapPhases.blurb: Install steering: rules, KPIs, alerts, governance, agreements and the optimisation engine.

roadmapPhases.name: Execute
roadmapPhases.blurb: Operationalise: derivation, approval, publication, rebates, bundles and the audit backbone.

strat.name: Pricing Strategy Lead
strat.desc: Owns the pricing operating model, segmentation and governance framework

pm.name: Product / Portfolio Pricing Manager
pm.desc: Sets and maintains list and product prices across the portfolio

analyst.name: Pricing Analyst
analyst.desc: Runs analysis, simulation, corridors and KPI monitoring

market.name: Market / Regional Pricer
market.desc: Derives local market, dealer and customer prices from central prices

kam.name: Key Account / Sales Manager
kam.desc: Manages customer-specific deals, agreements and approvals

controller.name: Controller / Finance
controller.desc: Guards margin floors, approves above-threshold moves, owns audit

datasci.name: Data Science / Optimisation
datasci.desc: Builds elasticity, value and margin models

ops.name: Pricing Operations / IT
ops.desc: Runs publication, distribution, integration and the data backbone

admin.name: System Admin / Key User
admin.desc: Maintains roles, master data, rules and configuration

tierLens.adv: At the Advanced Optimisation tier this step is model- and analytics-driven: the system scores, proposes, optimises and explains, and the expert validates.
tierLens.int: At the Integrated Management tier this step runs on governed rules, simulation and workflow: the everyday work of the pricing team.
tierLens.fnd: At the Foundational Operations tier this step is about reliable, high-volume execution and clean data upkeep by pricing officers.
